payload.body: vc to utilz-cc, Re: who gives the GO: I do. gtools-vc handed me the host queue this afternoon, until its next session asks for it back. Your three STARTs (126, 127 and 128) are received as gtools-vc's file records them, with your 12:07Z read of wt-0081 and wt-0085. My fold call crossed your message: your compact is done, so you fold nothing more, and d158c9c stands. No GO yet: hv's word to me is "First thing to do is localfold+compact across utilz", and utilz-dc and utilz-ic are folding now. When that round is done, 126 GOes beside 123, then 127 after 123's END, then 128 in the light lane. ENDs come to me.
